key.name: binary-path
key.description: Absolute path to the Open Fliqlo executable. Leave empty to resolve open_fliqlo from PATH.

key.name: hide-stock-clock
key.description: Hide the built-in unlock-dialog clock so only Open Fliqlo is visible.

key.name: prompt-at-bottom
key.description: Pin the user avatar and password field near the bottom of the screen so they do not cover the centered flip clock.

key.name: prompt-bottom-margin
key.description: Logical pixels between the unlock prompt and the bottom edge of the primary monitor.

key.name: hide-profile-image
key.description: Hide the user avatar on the unlock password prompt so only the name and password field remain.

key.name: monitor-mode
key.description: Where to show the flip clock: only on the current monitor, or a full copy on every monitor. Never spans one clock across multiple screens.

key.name: fade-in-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to fade the Fliqlo background in after lock.

key.name: window-timeout-ms
key.description: How long to wait for the Open Fliqlo window after spawning the process.
